title: Biomarker Changes - Use CPAP & Contact Provider
visual_summary: Dual warning for high AHI combined with low usage, urging consistent CPAP therapy.
narration_summary: Changes in your nighttime health signals can mean your sleep apnea is not fully controlled Wear your mask all night and contact your provider

start_scene_0_3s.description: Highlights combined high AHI and insufficient nightly usage.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Emphasizes health risk of untreated sleep apnea.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Directs patient to wear mask full night and call homecare provider.
